sources: agk-deployment-configs agentic-karl/stage/services/*/values.yaml (USE_REDIS, MEILI_HOST, AZURE_SEARCH_ENABLED, LANGFUSE_*, LOG_TO_FILE, AZURE_CONTAINER_NAME, Datadog annotations)
howToApprove: An entry resolves only when approvedBy + approvedAt (ISO date) are filled in a reviewed PR. Every not-probed or configured:"unknown" entry blocks an evidence run until it is replaced by a recorded fact.

sinks.label: Chat messages (incl. reasoning parts, feedback text)

baseline.note: librechat.yaml configures no `balance` block, so no Balance row is written. Confirm, then approve.
librechat.yaml sets `interface.presets: false` — users cannot create presets.
librechat.yaml sets `endpoints.azureOpenAI.assistants: false` and has no `endpoints.assistants` block, so no Assistants endpoint is offered.
Per-principal config overrides are written by admins only. Seed one for the test subject if a baseline is wanted instead.
Capability grants are written by admins only. Seed one for the test subject if a baseline is wanted instead.
Skill sync credentials are an admin/integration surface.
Allowlist rows are provisioned by admins; the test subject has one only if the migration allowlist is in use.
KNAUF_FILE_TRANSLATION_ENABLED is not set in this environment's GitOps values, so no translation job can be created. Remove this exemption when translation ships here.

sinks.label: Admin audit log rows naming the subject
sinks.basis: Art. 17(3)(b)/(e) — tamper-evident admin audit trail under the P2-7 position; the hash chain forbids row-level deletion
sinks.expiry: 12 months, purged by the KK20-328 retention sweep once enabled

sinks.label: Azure Blob container "files" (uploads, images, avatars)
sinks.note: PROPOSED: soft-deleted copies expire with the storage account's delete-retention window. Platform to confirm the account's actual retention days (and whether blob versioning is on) before approval; current and snapshot copies are always residuals.

sinks.label: Langfuse raw ingestion events — Blob agkblobstagewesteu, prefix events/
sinks.reason: Not yet confirmed on this instance that DELETE /api/public/traces removes the raw event objects under events/. Lead: the deployed Langfuse 3.194.1 keeps a blob-storage file log by default (LANGFUSE_ENABLE_BLOB_STORAGE_FILE_LOG is unset), which is what lets trace deletion remove them. Platform to confirm, then record this as eventually-deleted with the deletion queue deadline

sinks.label: Langfuse media — Blob agkblobstagewesteu, prefix media/
sinks.reason: Media deletion on trace deletion is not verified for this deployment. Platform to confirm and record here

sinks.label: Langfuse batch exports — Blob agkblobstagewesteu, prefix exports/ (LANGFUSE_S3_BATCH_EXPORT_ENABLED=true)
sinks.reason: An export is a copy a user downloaded into storage; trace deletion does not touch it. No lifecycle rule is recorded for exports/

sinks.label: Langfuse ClickHouse / Postgres backups
sinks.reason: Backup existence, retention and the no-restore-without-re-erasure rule are not recorded (P0-2 part 1)

sinks.label: Redis keys that embed the subject id (caches, pending requests, MCP tool caches)
sinks.note: The account cascade does not clear Redis; keys expire by TTL. A residual here names its namespaces — record the TTLs and switch to eventually-deleted if that is the position.

sinks.label: Redis entries keyed by session/token/stream ids (not addressable by subject)
sinks.reason: Cannot be found by subject id; the TTL of each namespace is not recorded. Record the TTLs and switch to eventually-deleted with the longest one as the deadline

sinks.label: Winston log files on the API pods
sinks.note: LOG_TO_FILE=false in GitOps — server logs go to stdout only

sinks.label: Server logs in the log platform (Datadog, site datadoghq.eu) — carry userId/tenantId/requestId
sinks.reason: Retention period and a per-subject deletion or expiry path are not recorded (DSAR runbook §1.10, P1-2). deleteUserController also logs the erased email at info (P0-4)

sinks.label: APM traces/profiles shipped to Datadog (OTLP)
sinks.reason: Whether spans carry user identifiers, and their retention, are not recorded

sinks.label: MongoDB/Cosmos backups and point-in-time restore
sinks.reason: Backup retention and the no-restore-without-re-erasure rule are not recorded (P0-5)

sinks.label: Blob storage backups / object replication beyond soft delete
sinks.reason: Whether Azure Backup or object replication holds further copies is not recorded

sinks.label: Meilisearch snapshots/dumps
sinks.reason: Whether snapshots or dumps are scheduled is not recorded

sinks.label: Files on the API pod filesystem
sinks.note: Any File row pointing at a local path makes this entry drift and blocks the run

sinks.label: Code-execution environment files
sinks.reason: no code-execution service is deployed in this environment

sinks.label: Azure OpenAI abuse-monitoring retention (processor)
sinks.basis: Microsoft retains prompts/completions for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring unless the opt-out is granted (P0-6). Deletion is Microsoft's, by expiry; no per-subject path exists

sinks.label: Azure AI Document Intelligence analysis results (RAG parsing)
sinks.basis: Analyze results are deleted by the service 24 h after the operation; nothing is stored beyond that

sinks.label: Corporate identity (Entra ID / Okta) the account signs in with
sinks.notification: Not an Art. 19 recipient — KARL receives the identity from it. If the request covers the corporate account itself, route it to IAM and record the hand-off on the DSAR register row
